SHURflo pressure switches that ARE pressure switches, per the vendor docs read in this sweep: 94-800-05 for the 4008 (911-1008 repair-kit table) and 94-910-02 for the 5050 (PDS-5050-1311-D011 repair-kit table). Neither is 94-136-00.

A pressure switch is a mechanical contact pair. It is the one part in this whole vendor's catalogue a gateway could genuinely sense — wire a pair in parallel with it and cabin-gpio sees the pump demand.
